baseline.format: raw flash code and padding, 0x10000000..0x100fe000; excludes journal/storage

rom_stack_audit.scope: direct stack paths, excludes interrupt costs; unresolved entries do not pass

WV.error: unresolved control/stack operation at 0x142: bx r6

bootstrap_method: 5000 independent trial resamples of median ratios, seed 20261022; five-trial intervals are descriptive and do not include systematic clock/boundary/observer uncertainty.

limitations: Unmodified baseline has no displayed-age/dependency stamps or main-stack watermark.
Legacy A-only presentation fields incorrectly read an unused transition counter and are excluded; layer throughput, CPU and latency remain valid.
20 Hz USB observer cost is distinct from internal instrumentation overhead; no telemetry-disabled firmware was built.
Package bytes are identical but flash extent addresses are not pinned across firmware blocks; code/data cache and scheduler costs are not causally isolated.
No one/two-worker factorial or 500/1000us slice sweep in this campaign.
Continuous-operation endurance uses one physical output; Pico 2 W, APA102/electrical probe and multiple physical outputs require separate hardware.
Rendered layer completions and distinct driver-completed contributions are software counters, not optical measurements.
Cumulative foreground-gap maxima include setup/flash; they cannot prove a steady-state 10ms ingress bound.

restoration.firmware: exact original full-flash backup, loaded with picotool -v -x and successful exit
restoration.storage_scope: All 13 objects restored by verified full-flash load; ten public program/preset byte hashes checked again over USB. Private network data excluded.

network-observer-summary.note: The preceding two commands belong to the preserved first post-flash timeout and its restoration attempt. Observer publication payloads and private broker configuration are not included.

continuity.scope: Continuous single-output campaign including USB, HTTP, MQTT, program uploads/deletes, scene replacements and explicit recovery from a rejected configuration. Final separate soak was 120.76 seconds; this is not an hour-long fixed HA workload.

acceptance.busy_preparation_usb_latency: fail under defined heavier observer load
